name: band8
description: Protocol-first, local-first IELTS personalized training runtime with an external Coach boundary.

scripts.test:writing: vitest run tests/runtime/writing-protocol.test.ts tests/runtime/artifact-store.test.ts tests/runtime/writing-runtime.test.ts tests/runtime/continuation-runtime.test.ts tests/runtime/writing-golden.test.ts
scripts.test:idempotency: vitest run tests/runtime/storage-runtime.test.ts tests/runtime/runtime-golden.test.ts -t "persists import identity|different canonical content|duplicate resume|rebuilds"
scripts.verify:protocol: python tests/protocol/validate_protocol.py all . && python -m unittest discover -s tests/protocol -p "test_*.py" -v
scripts.verify:release: npm run verify:protocol && npm test && npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm run test:parity
